verdict.rationale: Self-serve document automation is a fair question for a law firm, since firms can and do ship client-facing assembly tools, so the axis applies. The only technology evidence ([gide-supp-legaltech]) cites AI, automated translation and a blockchain-based trading platform used internally to optimise its own services. Nothing in the pack shows an online, interactive document-assembly product founders can complete themselves, and fundraising documentation is described only as lawyer-drafted.
